scope: human-only evidence for hook-class temporal coding and predictive presynaptic inhibition

hook_class_evidence.claim: FeCO hook proprioceptors encode tibia movement with phasic, directionally tuned responses, whereas claw proprioceptors encode position tonically.
Movement-encoding hook axons are selectively suppressed during self-generated walking and grooming, while position-encoding proprioceptor axons remain active across behaviours.
GABAergic 9A interneurons provide presynaptic inhibition to movement-encoding hook axons and receive descending input positioned to drive context-specific and leg-specific suppression.
Activity of the inhibitory interneurons and their descending inputs correlates with self-generated but not passive leg movements.
Hook axons receive abundant inhibitory presynaptic input, prominently from 9A neurons, while hook and claw pathways connect to local leg motor circuits.

malecns_context.claim: MaleCNS SNpp39 and SNpp41 are FeCO hook proprioceptive sensory types and belong to the proprioceptive grouping with strong connectivity from inhibitory hemilineage 09A.

temporal_resolution_boundary.claim: Calcium dynamics were too slow to determine whether 9A activity precedes movement or whether sensory suppression is phase-locked within the movement cycle; faster measurements such as voltage imaging are required for that temporal resolution.

identity_boundary.rule: Hook-class predictive inhibition evidence must not be used to promote the SNpp39/SNpp41 direction inference into an executable type-level mapping.

allowed_human_only_analysis: detect receptor pulse onset and offset from already-recorded handoff history
measure engineering handoff lag in decision-index units
compare self-generated proxy histories across actions for diagnostics only
forbidden_promotions: derive a millisecond inhibitory kernel from calcium traces
inject 9A-like inhibition into SNpp39 or SNpp41
convert hook-class suppression into a systematic-type direction label
route motor command or world truth into the receptor history
treat temporal correlation as neuron identity evidence
next_evidence_gate: Require phase-resolved or otherwise quantitatively time-resolved hook/9A physiology, plus an independently validated MaleCNS target identity path, before proposing any executable predictive-inhibition kernel.
